=You are a professional tech news journalist. Every day you receive a digest of the latest news articles from major tech publications. Your job is to pick the most newsworthy story (or combine 2-3 related stories into one narrative) and write an original, polished news article. ## Today's News Digest {{ $json.articlesSummary }} ## Tools Available - **Fetch Article**: Pass a full article URL (including https://) to read the complete text. Use this to get the full details of the articles you want to write about. ## Your Task 1. Review the headlines and snippets above. 2. Pick the single most important/interesting story, OR pick 2-3 related stories you can weave into one narrative. 3. Use the Fetch Article tool to read the full text of your chosen 2-3 articles. Do NOT fetch more than 3. 4. If a fetch fails (paywall, error), skip it and work with what you have. 5. Write an original news article based on what you've read. ## NEWS ARTICLE STRUCTURE ### Headline Clear, factual, attention-grabbing. ### Lead Paragraph (1 paragraph) The most important facts: who, what, when, where, why. ### Body (3-5 paragraphs, use

subheadings where appropriate) - Key details and context - Background and significance - Multiple perspectives where available - Concrete data, numbers, or specifics ### What's Next (1-2 paragraphs) Implications, what to watch for, what happens next. ## WRITING RULES - Neutral, professional journalistic tone - 600-1000 words - All content ORIGINAL — synthesize and rewrite, never copy - Attribute sources naturally (e.g. "according to Ars Technica", "The Verge reports") - Use

,

, , for formatting - Do NOT include , , or tags ## OUTPUT FORMAT Return in this EXACT format: TITLE: [Your headline] ---CONTENT--- [Full article in HTML]

parameters.content:
## 📡 RSS Feed Sources
Pulls the latest articles from four tech publications:
- **BBC Technology**
- **The Verge**
- **Ars Technica**
- **TechCrunch**

### Customizing
- Swap any feed URL to cover different topics or outlets.
- To add more feeds: duplicate an RSS node, connect it to the Merge node, and increase the Merge node's `numberInputs` value.

## 🔧 Processing Pipeline
1. **Normalize Fields** — Standardizes all feeds to a common schema (title, snippet, link, date, source) since each RSS feed returns slightly different field names.
2. **Filter Last 24h** — Drops anything older than 24 hours so the AI only sees fresh news.
3. **Sort by Date** — Newest articles first.
4. **Limit** — Caps the list (default: 10) so the AI prompt stays focused and within token limits.

## 📝 Publish to WordPress
The AI returns output in a structured format (TITLE + CONTENT).

**Parse AI Output** extracts the headline and HTML body.
**Create WordPress Draft** posts it as a draft to your site.

### Requires
- **WordPress API credential** (site URL + application password)
- Default status: `draft` — change to `publish` in node settings if you want posts to go live immediately.

## 📰 AI-Powered Daily Tech News Writer
Automatically writes and publishes an original tech news article every morning.

**Flow:** RSS Feeds → Merge & Filter → AI Agent writes article → WordPress Draft

### Prerequisites
- OpenAI API key
- WordPress site with application password

### Customization
- Swap RSS feeds for different topics
- Change the schedule trigger time
- Adjust article count limit
- Switch AI model in the OpenAI Chat Model node

Built with ❤️ for hands-free content creation.

## 🤖 AI News Writer
The Code node compiles all articles into a single text digest.

The AI Agent (OpenAI) then:
1. Reviews headlines and snippets
2. Picks the most newsworthy story (or combines 2-3 related stories)
3. Uses the **Fetch Article** tool to read full article text (max 3 fetches)
4. Writes an original 600-1000 word article in journalistic style

### Requires
- **OpenAI API credential** (set in the "OpenAI Chat Model" sub-node)
- Model defaults to `gpt-5.1` — change as needed
